claims: Written notice for extra cost under CIAP 20.08 is due within fifteen days after receipt of the instruction, drawing, or specification involving a change.
Owner-attributable delay notice is due within fifteen days after recognition of the delay.
Actual direct cost claims require vouchers and supporting documents.
Unresolved construction contract disputes may proceed through CIAC arbitration under CIAP 102 and EO 1008.
